# Senate PSI: Medicare Advantage post-acute prior-auth denials

- Citation: US Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, Majority Staff Report, "Refusal of Recovery", 2024-10-17. https://www.hsgac.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024.10.17-PSI-Majority-Staff-Report-on-Medicare-Advantage.pdf ; summary: https://www.aha.org/news/headline/2024-10-17-senate-report-scrutinizes-medicare-advantage-prior-authorization-denials-post-acute-care-services
- Year: 2024 (data 2019-2022)
- Tier: 1 (government; majority staff report)
- Sample / method: more than 280,000 pages of internal documents from UnitedHealthcare, Humana and CVS.
- Key findings: in 2022, UHC and CVS denied post-acute prior-auth requests at about 3x their overall denial rates; Humana at more than 16x. UnitedHealth's post-acute denial rate rose from 8.7% to 22.7% (2019-2022), and its SNF denial rate rose ninefold, coinciding with use of the nH Predict algorithm.
- Limits: majority staff report, not bipartisan; three insurers only. Figures come from the AHA summary and search summaries; the full PDF was not read.
